info.title: Anchanto OMS (SelluSeller) Open API — JPluger-called surface
info.description:
The subset of the Anchanto OMS (SelluSeller) Open API that JPluger actually calls, reconstructed from the JPluger source rather than from an OMS-published document.

Scope: every path reached via the `SS_DOMAIN` / `selluseller.open.api.base.url` base URL. The WMS3 product API (`WMS_3_URL` / `WREO_DOMAIN`, e.g. `/rest/v2/customers/{customer_code}/...`) is a different Anchanto product and is deliberately excluded. Note that `/rest/v2` alone does not mean WMS3: OMS has its own v2 inventory endpoints (`/rest/v2/inventory_products/*`), which are in scope.

## Serialization trap
Two serializers are in play and they disagree on field names.

- **Request bodies** built with `gson.toJson(...)` — the marketplace-connector, wms-connector, ss-connector and selluseller-connector write paths — are **Gson**-serialized. The wire key is `@SerializedName` if present, otherwise the *raw Java field name* (these DTOs use snake_case Java field names). `@JsonProperty` is ignored there; it describes the inbound Kafka/Rabbit payload, not the OMS wire format. Gson omits nulls and skips `transient` fields.
- Request bodies passed as a POJO to `restManager.post/patch(...)` or `new HttpEntity<Dto>(...)` are **Jackson**-serialized, so `@JsonProperty` wins.
- **All responses** are Jackson-deserialized, so `@JsonProperty` is the wire name.

Each operation records its real call sites in `x-jpluger-callers`. Operations marked `x-jpluger-status: constant-only` have a path constant in the source but no live call site — their verb and body are inferred, so treat them as lower-confidence when building a mock.

## Auth
`POST /oauth/token` uses grant_type `authorization_code` with a JSON body and returns `access_token`; every other operation sends `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`.

post.summary: Exchange an authorization code for an OMS access token
post.description: OAuth2 authorization_code grant against SelluSeller/OMS. Called during the SelluSeller app-install callback. All parameters travel in a JSON request body (Content-Type: application/json, Accept: */*) - NOT in the query string and NOT form-urlencoded. The body is a POJO handed to restManager.post(url, headers, dto, JsonNode.class), so Jackson serialisation applies and @JsonProperty wins: client_id, client_secret, grant_type, code, redirect_uri. grant_type is injected from the ${GRANT_TYPE} property, which is 'authorization_code' in every environment properties file. JPluger reads only 'access_token' out of the response. Calling modules: marketplace-connector (connector/marketplace-connector/src/main/java/com/anchanto/connector/marketplace/publisher/AuthenticationService.java:140-153), wms-connector (connector/wms-connector/src/main/java/com/anchanto/connector/wms/publisherService/AuthenticationService.java:126-134), marketplace-core (marketplace-integrations/marketplace-core/src/main/java/com/anchanto/marketplace/core/service/AuthenticationService.java:226-247), carrier-integration (carrier-integration/src/main/java/com/anchanto/carrier/integration/service/AuthenticationService.java:134-154).

get.summary: Retrieve inventory products (paged / filtered by isku or updated window)
get.description:
Union of three distinct JPluger call sites.
(1) wms-integrations-legacy OIP call object `GetInventoryProducts` builds the URL at wms-integrations/wms-integrations-legacy/src/main/java/com/anchanto/wms/integration/utils/GetInventoryProducts.java:135 and is executed by the iStoreiSend scheduled product sync at wms-integrations/wms-integrations-legacy/src/main/java/com/anchanto/wms/integration/isis/service/IStoreISendWmsScheduledService.java:137 (sends limit, offset, updated_before, updated_after).
(2) wms-integration-core OIP call object at wms-integrations/wms-integration-core/src/main/java/com/anchanto/wms/integration/core/utils/oip/inventory/product/GetInventoryProducts.java:138 (sends limit, offset, isku, updated_before, updated_after) - no live caller found in this repo, the only import is unused in wms-integrations/sap-elc-integration/src/main/java/com/anchanto/wms/integration/sap/elc/service/ELCProductService.java:16.

Response is deserialised with Jackson (@JsonProperty wins).
Status handling: legacy caller treats 404 as 'no more pages' and stops; 5xx / 429 are retried up to a max retry limit; selluseller-connector rethrows 5xx and 429 as OipException for RabbitMQ retry.

OrderUpdateCancelledStockItem.description: Gson view of CancelledItemDTO; raw field names line_item_id, sellable, damaged.

OrderUpdateCancelledStockRequest.description: Gson view of selluseller-connector UpdateCancelledOrderStockDTO. putaway_method and skip_quantity_adjustment_in_oms carry @SerializedName; id, items and eventParametersDTO have none, so Gson uses the raw field names (note the camelCase eventParametersDTO on the wire).

OrderUpdateCancelledStockResponse.description: Response body of update_cancelled_order_stock. selluseller-connector reads it as a raw String and only inspects the status code.

OrderUpdateDetailsPayload.description: Gson view of UpdateOrderDetailsDTO. Wire keys are the raw field names — note the two camelCase ones isOrderItemChange and orderNumber, which Gson emits verbatim because they have no @SerializedName. Only order_extra_data is renamed by @SerializedName.

OrderUpdateDetailsRequest.description: Gson view of UpdateOrderDetailsRequestDTO; single raw field name `order`.

OrderUpdateResponse.description: Jackson view of OrderUpdateResponseDTO extends BaseOrderResponseDTO<OrderItemUpdateResponseDTO>. Used by cancel, mark_complete, update_status, mark_approve_or_reject, revert_seller_cancellation and acknowledge_orders. The item list arrives under `line_items`.

error.description: Non-null even on 2xx bodies for some failures; every caller checks it.

OrderUpdateResponseItem.description: Jackson view of OrderItemUpdateResponseDTO. Note the two renames relative to the base class: the item id arrives as `id` (not order_item_id) and the item codes as `mp_item_codes` (not item_codes).

OrderWithholdObject.description: Gson view of WithHoldObject; keys from @SerializedName.

Payout.description: Gson view of StatementDTO; @SerializedName wins, so adjustment_amount / fee_amount / payment_id / payment_status / revenue_amount / settlement_amount / statement_time / marketplace_code / store_code are the wire keys, while currency and id keep their field names.

PayoutRequest.description: Gson view of StatementRequestDTO; the envelope key is the raw field name `payout`.

PayoutResponse.description: Read as a raw JsonNode by JPluger, so no DTO pins the shape.

PromotionFailureReasonsRequest.description: Inferred - no DTO exists for this constant-only endpoint.

ShippingMethodRequest.description: Body of POST /rest/v1/shipping_methods. Gson-serialised from ShippingMethodDTO, so @JsonProperty is ignored and the raw Java field names are the wire keys - note supportReturnOrder is camelCase because the field is.

update_status.description: String in the DTO, not a boolean.

supportReturnOrder.description: Raw Java field name; Gson does not rename it.

ShippingMethodResponse.description: From CreateShippingCarrierResponseDTO. JPluger reads name and logistics_partner_code to build the SMP follow-up.

is_self_service.description: Returned as a string by OMS.

ShippingMethodSummary.description: Row of the shipping-method list responses (shippingcarrier/PayloadTO).

SmpShippingMethod.description: Inner object of the SMP create body. Gson-serialised from CreateSMPShippingCarrierRequestDTO; every field carries @SerializedName so these snake_case names are authoritative even though several fields also carry a differing @JsonProperty.

SmpShippingMethodPatch.description: Inner object of the (constant-only) SMP update request, from SmpShippingMethodTO - Jackson names.

SmpShippingMethodRequest.description: Body of POST /rest/v1/smp_shipping_methods. The envelope key is the raw field name of SmpShippingMethodDTO.

SmpShippingMethodSummary.description: Row of the SMP list/create responses (smpshippingcarrier/PayloadTO).

Store.description: One OMS store row. Union of PayloadTO (selluseller-connector) and StoreResponseDTO (wms-integration-core); the WMS DTO adds marketplace_code, state, branch_code and is_global_marketplace.

StoreSyncTime.description: Inner object of the sync-time PATCH. Gson-serialised from StoreSyncTimeDTO; every field carries @SerializedName. Date values use Gson's default Date format because no spring.gson.date-format is configured.

inventory_sync.description: Always set to 'now' by the caller.

Transaction.description: Gson view of TransactionDTO; every field except `amount` carries @SerializedName, and `amount` keeps its field name.

UpdateBrandRequest.description: From UpdateBrandRequestTO (Jackson names). No live call site.

UpdateCategoryAttributeRequest.description: From UpdateCategoryAttributesRequestTO (Jackson names); category_attributes is a single object here, not a list. No live call site.

UpdateCategoryRequest.description: From UpdateCategoryRequestTO (Jackson names). No live call site.

UpdateSmpShippingMethodRequest.description: From UpdatesmpShippingCarrierRequestTO (Jackson names). No live call site.

UpdateStoreSyncTimeRequest.description: Body of PATCH /rest/v1/stores/{id}. Gson-serialised from UpdateStoreSyncTimeRequestDTO whose only field carries @SerializedName("store"). The legacy connectors' UpdateStoreRequestTO/StoreTO produce the same keys via Jackson.

UserMeResponse.description: Mapped into UserInfoDTO by Jackson; @JsonProperty names are the wire names. JPluger consumes seller_code, seller_id, base_currency, is_multiwarehousing, id and email.

id.description: SelluSeller user id, stored as User.sellusellerUserId.

seller_tag.description: Free-form; typed as Object in the DTO.

Warehouse.description: From PayloadTO (selluseller-connector Warehouse package) plus the `email` field that WarehouseDetailsDTO reads in wms-integration-core.
